root_idea.summary: The root centers on uncovering, clearing, and making something manifest.
root_idea.development: From removing a covering or sweeping something clear, the root develops meanings involving the clearing of darkness, radiant appearance, travel as departure from a place, writing that reveals what is hidden, and mediation that removes estrangement.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic Form IV verb is a distinct lexical form meaning to become bright or shine.
The Quranic plural أَسْفَار has two independently attested lexical uses: journeys and books.
The Quranic active-participial adjective is presented under its singular citation form.
This is the Quranic noun for journey or travel.
The Quranic plural سَفَرَة is presented under the supported singular active-participial citation form سَافِر.

senses.definition: To become bright or shine; in the Quran, said of the dawn as it becomes luminous and clear.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is in the perfect active Form IV, with الصبح as subject.
Plural of سَفَر in the Quranic use referring to journeys undertaken or left behind.

senses.definition: Books or writings, especially writings that disclose or convey knowledge.
senses.usage_conditions: Plural of سِفْر; in the Quranic occurrence, the books are carried without their contents being understood.

senses.definition: Radiant, shining, or bright with gladness.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic feminine singular form مُسْفِرَةٌ describes faces; the related lexical use is especially associated with a face whose brightness expresses happiness or beauty.
Used as a noun for going forth from one's settled place; the Quran also uses it in the legal and practical context of being on a journey.

senses.definition: A writer or scribe; in the Quranic plural سَفَرَة, the noble celestial scribes or recorders.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the plural سَفَرَةٌ. Classical usage also applies the plural to ordinary writers and to angels who register actions; the Quranic context identifies the intended scribes as honored and righteous.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sweep or clean a house or chamber.
To sweep away, disperse, or remove something from a covering or surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of wind sweeping away dust, leaves, or clouds, and of removing what covers something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To uncover, expose, or make apparent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The direct object may be something previously covered; the form is also used of uncovering the face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mediate between people, reconcile them, or settle a dispute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The conventional expression سَفَرَ بَيْنَ القَوْمِ refers to exposing what is hidden between the parties in order to make peace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the sun to rise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical use associated with the sun's becoming visible.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go away or decline.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively of fat disappearing and of war subsiding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go forth on a journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An obsolete or little-used verbal sense; the noun سَفَر is the normal surviving form for journey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To write a book or written text.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is a book or writing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a سِفَار, or nose-gear, on a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized camel-handling construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sell the best of one's sheep or goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized livestock-trade use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send someone on a journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pasture or feed animals at twilight, or to train an animal for strength in travelling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of camels pastured in the pre-night whiteness and of a horse fed or trained for travel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To kindle a fire or make it blaze brightly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For winds to vie with one another in sweeping away or effacing traces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III construction used of winds successively erasing one another's tracks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To journey or travel to a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III verbal usage with a destination; the noun سَفَر and the traveller noun are related but distinct lexical forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or euphemistic Form III use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the sun to decline from the middle of the sky.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form III use describing the sun's movement away from the zenith.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a fever to depart from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form III use with an illness as subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a tree to become stripped of its leaves, with the leaves changed in color and whitened.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV use of a tree affected by wind and loss of foliage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the moon to cause a shining in the sky before rising.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV use concerning pre-rise illumination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter the time of dawn or perform prayer in the dawn's brightness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction أَسْفَرَ بِالصَّلَاةِ concerns performing the dawn prayer when dawn has become manifest or white.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For war to become vehement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical Form IV use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come or remain during the whiteness of day, especially the twilight before night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person arriving and of camels pasturing in the pre-night whiteness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek the brightest or most beautiful women for marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is women considered in respect of facial brightness and beauty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attain or obtain part of what one wants before it becomes unreachable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical Form V use concerning partial attainment of an objective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek from someone part of a claim or debt owed by him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring especially to obtaining an equitable half of a claim.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For skin to receive a mark or impression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Derived from سَفْر in the sense of a trace or mark.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For clouds to disperse or be removed from the face of the sky.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VII inchoative or middle usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the forepart of the head to become divested of hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VII use describing loss of covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For camels to go away into the country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VII use describing animals dispersing into open land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the sun to become white before setting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed or tentative Form IX usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send someone as a messenger or سفير.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X usage with a person as the dispatched representative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mark, impression, trace, or vestige that remains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may refer to a remaining track or mark.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An erased mark or trace, in a reported interpretation of a poetic usage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized and interpretive poetic application, distinct from the ordinary meaning of book or writing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The whiteness of dawn, daylight, or the twilight whiteness before night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can refer to morning brightness, remaining daylight after sunset, or pre-night whiteness according to context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food prepared for a traveller or for a journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic nominal sense of the journey provisions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The receptacle or piece of skin in which travel food is placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived concrete use of the same noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spread, tray, or other surface on which food is eaten.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is named for being spread out for eating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of iron, cord, or leather placed over a camel's nose and jaws as a control device.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized item of camel tack.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Leaves swept away by the wind, including fallen leaves and plant matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun emphasizes the leaves' being swept away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A messenger, especially a mediator or peacemaker between parties.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The messenger exposes or communicates what is at issue between people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A commissioned agent, factor, deputy, or representative.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader representative role derived from acting in another person's place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sweepings or material swept together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for what has been swept away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mediation, reconciliation, or the office of a messenger or ambassador.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun and institutional designation connected with سَفَرَ بَيْنَ القَوْمِ and سَفِير.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The falling of hair from above the forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman whose face is uncovered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine active-participial use; this classical specialization is not a separate Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse having little flesh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare figurative or specialized animal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part or parts of the face that appear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting an exposed portion of the face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or tract for travelling through.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural مَسَافِر may denote extensive tracts between places.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel somewhat beyond the صَهْبَاء degree of redness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of an animal's color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person or animal that travels much or is strong for travelling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a camel, and also to a man or woman accustomed to travel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A broom or implement with which one sweeps.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrument noun derived from sweeping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who binds books or covers them with leather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The books in question are أَسْفَار, books or writings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Distressed or fatigued by journeying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of the result of travel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person journeying or travelling; a traveller or wayfarer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III active participle; it may also function as a collective or quasi-plural expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name applied to a wild cow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized poetic usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quince; also, in a specialized expression, a species of custard-apple called Indian quince.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun with a conventional plural سَفَارِج; the Indian species is a distinct specialized application of the same expression.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The face-brightness lexical branch is covered by the Quran-attested related participle.
Editorial discussion of word-pattern validity, not an additional lexical meaning.

cautions: أَسْفَار is a single Quranic form group with two vocalized lexical bases: the plural of سَفَر, journeys, and the plural of سِفْر, books or writings.
The classical interpretation of سِفْر as an erased trace in the cited poetic passage is specialized and reported as an interpretation rather than the ordinary book sense.
Some rare Form I, derived-form, animal, and technical uses are classical extensions and should not be read as additional Quranic senses.
